currency.basis: Favicon and pinned-tab SVG fetched live from postbank.de on 2026-10-03; brand portal active. Postbank remains an operating brand under Deutsche Bank AG.

identity.basis: Record is Postbank (DE, postbank.de); the official design assets carry the Postbank three-wave mark.

assessment.independenceRationale: Two distinct official assets from postbank.de's design package corroborate each other; the search pass found no contradicting source.

variant.basis: Fetched replacement is the official colored variant: three waves (blue #0a3478, red #e10014) on Postbank yellow #ffcc00. Identical wave geometry to the accepted icon, corrected brand colors.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Wave contours, gaps between waves, corner cuts and relative geometry identical to the source raster; colors exact per official palette; internal shape edges clean at 240px and 24/32/48px diagnostics; no lost detail.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Emblem proportions preserved by uniform scale; whole emblem fits the circle with even margins (~5px horizontal, ~12px vertical in 54px cell); recognizable and legible at 24px on light and dark themes; no clipping of any wave.
candidate.rationale: The accepted icon reproduces the Postbank three-wave mark with visibly off-brand colors (yellow #f3c415, blue-violet #201a51, dull red #d33339) compared with the live official postbank.de favicon (#ffcc00 yellow, #0a3478 blue, #e10014 red). The replacement uses the official original vector's exact wave geometry and brand colors; this is a supported color correction, not a rebrand.
candidate.role: Standalone Postbank three-wave mark (two blue waves, one red wave) on a circular Postbank-yellow catalog field; no accompanying name or slogan.
transforms: Whole-emblem uniform scale 2.9 and translation (3.795, 3.78) of the official favicon.svg wave paths (16x16 grid) onto a 54x54 canvas; no rotation, stretching, recoloring, or path edits.

Background-only adaptation: the square #ffcc00 source field replaced by a same-color circle of diameter 54; all wave vertices verified inside the circle (max radius 26.4 of 27); emblem geometry byte-derived from the official source.

SVGO 4.1.0 (config sha256 f2a406e0..., frozen worktree svgo.config.mjs) on a copy: 931 -> 663 bytes; trial selected because it is smaller and visually faithful (max pixel difference 1/255 on a 240px independent rasterizer render); final = optimized trial.
candidate.variant: Official colored variant from the live postbank.de favicon.svg: blue #0a3478 and red #e10014 waves on #ffcc00 yellow. Presentation is the catalog circular backing of the plain square yellow field, matching the accepted icon's established circular presentation; no official circular avatar was observed or claimed.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Base and final differ visibly in color only: the same wave geometry renders in dull off-brand shades in the base and in the official #ffcc00/#0a3478/#e10014 palette in the final, confirmed in side-by-side Desktop renders on both themes.

proposals.reason: Current icon reproduces the Postbank three-wave mark with visibly off-brand colors (#f3c415/#201a51/#d33339) compared with the live official postbank.de favicon (#ffcc00/#0a3478/#e10014).
